Overview of Rajasthan Geography

Rajasthan is divided into four major physical divisions:

  • Western Sandy Plain (Thar Desert)
  • Aravalli Range and Hilly Region
  • Eastern Plains
  • South-Eastern Plateau (Hadoti)
